description: OpenTUMFlex, published by Technical University of Munich, quantifies and prices household-device flexibility relative to optimized operating schedules. Coverage: The model concerns configurable household devices, including PV, batteries, EVs, heat pumps and CHP. German and Californian EV applications are examples, not the only permitted geography. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is GPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
